name: Constraint Manifold Identity
description: Replaced the original positive-definite matrix quadratic form with an identity on a constraint manifold. The triplet is critically flawed if the sum of products of coefficients of linked pairs is identically -0.5 for all coefficients summing to 0 with sum of squares 1. This identity holds if and only if all three edges are present, completely bypassing the original shortcut while preserving the exact same valid triplets.
